description: Implementation of E2SM RIC control service classes and methods, including control request handling, support checking, and execution logic for different control styles.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base
classes.description: Base class for E2SM RIC control services, providing style definition and executor management.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service
classes.description: Derived class implementing control request support and execution for styles 1-10.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255
classes.description: Specialized control service class for style 255, supporting control request creation and execution.

methods.name: get_control_style_definition
methods.description: Constructs and returns the control style definition object.

methods.name: add_e2sm_rc_control_action_executor
methods.description: Adds a control action executor to the service.

methods.name: control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported based on style and parameters.

methods.name: execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request asynchronously, returning a response.

methods.name: create_req_f1_from_req_f2
